'''"Gunner" Ferren''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where he trained fellow Sith in the art of manufacturing weapons.
